sql:
SELECT n.nspname AS schema,c.relname AS table,obj_description(c.oid,'pg_class') AS description,
has_schema_privilege(n.oid,'USAGE') AS schema_usage,has_table_privilege(c.oid,'SELECT') AS table_select
FROM pg_class c JOIN pg_namespace n ON n.oid=c.relnamespace
WHERE c.relkind IN ('r','v','m','p','f') AND n.nspname !~ '^(pg_|information_schema)' AND
(n.nspname ~* '(china|csmar|wind|cnrds|resset|gta|lseg|refinitiv|tick)' OR
((c.relname || ' ' || coalesce(obj_description(c.oid,'pg_class'),'')) ~* '(china|chinese|shanghai|shenzhen|csi 300|csi 500|csi 1000)' AND
(c.relname || ' ' || coalesce(obj_description(c.oid,'pg_class'),'')) ~* '(minute|intraday|high.frequency|tick)')) ORDER BY 1,2
